# Credo

> Credo is a free, account free web app for handing someone a password, an API key, a private note or a small file. The browser encrypts the payload with AES-256-GCM before anything is uploaded, so the stored record is ciphertext only. The recipient needs both the link and the passphrase, and every link expires on a schedule the sender picks.

Canonical address: https://lowkey.tools/credo

## What it does

- Encrypts text or a file locally with AES-256-GCM, using Argon2id (m=47104 KiB, t=1, p=1, the OWASP interactive configuration) to derive the key from a passphrase. Argon2id is memory hard, so every guess an attacker makes costs 46 MiB of RAM, which is what makes large scale GPU cracking uneconomical.
- Generates a fresh 16 byte salt and 12 byte nonce for every share, and stores them alongside the ciphertext inside a single base64 envelope.
- Uploads only that envelope plus a creation timestamp, an expiry timestamp and, for files, the original name and MIME type.
- Returns a share link and a QR code. The passphrase is never part of the link and is never transmitted.
- Expires every share automatically, between ten minutes and thirty days after creation. Thirty days is both the default and the maximum retention, and the ceiling is enforced when the record is written rather than only in the interface.
- Keeps the sender's list of created links in their own browser using IndexedDB. There is no server side index and listing is blocked at the database level.

## What it deliberately does not do

- It does not store, transmit or recover passphrases. A lost passphrase means the ciphertext stays sealed permanently.
- It does not require an account, an email address or any sign in.
- It does not run analytics on the contents of a share.
- It is not built for large files. The practical ceiling is about 700 KB per share.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lowkey.tools/credo): what Credo is, how it works, and the full feature list.
- [Share a secret](https://lowkey.tools/credo/new): compose a note or attach a file, set a passphrase and an expiry, get a link and a QR code.
- [Open a secret](https://lowkey.tools/credo/open): enter a share id and passphrase to decrypt.
- [My links](https://lowkey.tools/credo/links): the local, browser only history of links you created, with copy buttons and QR codes.
- [Security model](https://lowkey.tools/credo/security): the exact cryptography, the threat model and the trade offs.
- [Questions](https://lowkey.tools/credo/faq): direct answers to the questions people actually ask.
- [Terms of use](https://lowkey.tools/credo/terms)
- [Privacy](https://lowkey.tools/credo/privacy)
